rv.q: Hamlet Hail to the Thief works as a lucid, angsty revenge tragedy, played with clarity and verve.
Technically spectacular, Radiohead’s 2003 concept album in conversation with Shakespeare is an innovation in form
This version certainly packs a punch and hurtles you along for 1 hour 50 and was totally deserving of the standing ovation it received.
I fell in love with this fast-paced distillation of the play, condensed in just over 100 minutes, with no interval.

cn.t: Critics praise this fusion of Shakespeare and Radiohead as an "achingly cool" and "intriguing" collaboration that lives up to the hype, with the music seamlessly woven into a tragedy played with clarity and verve.
